title: Wreckage on the south road
description: A cart on its side, a dead ox, arrows still standing in the boards. Whoever did this took the horses and left the flour. Somewhere under the cart, someone is breathing.

choices.text: Lift the cart. Someone's alive under there.

onPass.narration: The cart comes up on your shoulders and a carter crawls out, bloodied and grateful. He presses his purse into your hands before you can refuse it.

onFail.narration: The cart shifts, slips, and comes down on your fingers before you get it clear. The carter is alive. Your hands will remember this.

choices.text: Take the flour and move on.

onPass.narration: Two sacks, dusty but whole. The breathing under the cart stops while you tie them on. You do not look back.
